nodes.title: SG-8.4.2 Loading message while history loads, list stays rendered
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet already renders 'Loading your suggestions…' while listMine is pending and always renders the 'Your suggestions' list. Gap: historyStatus starts as 'loading' and the history effect returns early when roundId is '' or the sheet is closed, so the message stays visible forever in that state, which the 401-retry test in tests/contribution.test.tsx uses. Desired behavior: the message appears only while a history request is in flight, and the list remains rendered so the 401-retry test still passes unchanged. Why: avoid a permanent misleading loading state.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given roundId is 'round-1' and listMine is pending, when the sheet opens, then 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown and the 'Your suggestions' list is rendered
- Given roundId is '', when the sheet opens, then 'Loading your suggestions…' is not shown and the 'Your suggestions' list is rendered
- Given the existing 401-retry test, when it runs, then it passes unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet history status initialisation
- Out of scope: API client changes
- Out of scope: Retry and error UI changes
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Preserve: Existing loading, error and Retry behavior
- Preserve: aria-label 'Your suggestions' list
- Preserve: Merge of history with in-flight entries


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript; keep the HistoryStatus type 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'
- No mock data replacing the real listMine call


## Definition of done
- Loading message never persists without a request in flight
- Existing contribution tests remain green


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Loading message is shown only while history is loading and the list stays rendered
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx line 47 initialises historyStatus to 'loading' and the effect at L50-L76 returns early without changing it when !open or roundId === ''. Desired behavior: with no round id or a closed sheet there is no request, so status must not be 'loading'. Expected result: the loading message is absent in that case and present while listMine is pending. Why: removes a stuck message and keeps the 401-retry test passing.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given roundId is '' when the sheet is open, then no 'Loading your suggestions…' text is rendered
- Given roundId is set and listMine is pending, then 'Loading your suggestions…' is rendered and the list 'Your suggestions' exists
- Given the 401-retry scenario with roundId '', then the three ordered POST calls occur and the list shows 'Sent'


## Scope
- In scope: historyStatus initial value and early-return branch in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: Retry button behavior
- Out of scope: Error message text
- Preserve: HISTORY_LOADING and HISTORY_ERROR texts
- Preserve: Cancellation guard in the effect


## Technical constraints
- Keep the single-writer history status in ContributionSheet


## Definition of done
- Behavior matches acceptance criteria


## Clarifying questions
- None

## Acceptance criteria
- With roundId '' the status is 'ready' on first render
- With roundId set the status is 'loading' until listMine settles


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet.tsx historyStatus initial state and early-return branch
- Out of scope: Tests
- Out of scope: API client
- Preserve: Loading and error rendering at L153-L157
- Preserve: Cancelled-flag guards


## Technical constraints
- Do not add a second status state; keep a single writer
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx`


## Definition of done
- Loading message absent when roundId is ''
- Product code compiles with tsc


## Clarifying questions
- None
